summary: Implemented Graph.cbd(resource) in rdflib/graph.py as the last Graph method before ConjunctiveGraph, with a nested add_to_cbd helper covering rule 1 (subject triples, blank-node expansion guarded by the result), and rule 3 (all triples of every rdf:subject reifier, no type or predicate/object checks). Added test/test_graph_cbd.py with class CbdTestCase (testCbd, testCbdEmpty, testCbdReified, testCbdUntypedReifier, testCbdIncomingReification, testCbdBlankNodeInReification, testCbdBlankNodeCycle, testCbdImmutable) and a main guard. Tests were not run, per instructions; expected counts were verified by reading the fixture only. Nothing was committed.
